def headmats(l,h):

    w1=W[f'ln1_w.{l}']
    return W[f'W_q.{l}'][s]*w1, W[f'W_k.{l}'][s]*w1, W[f'W_v.{l}'][s]*w1, W[f'W_o.{l}'][:,s]
sink=[21,39,58,99,184]; mask=np.ones(384,bool); mask[sink]=False
